entries.name: Minnesota State Fair
entries.capsule: Twelve days ending on Labor Day at the St. Paul fairgrounds, a yearly meeting of farm and city.
entries.dateRule: Twelve days ending on Labor Day; organizer announces.
entries.whatItMarks: A statewide gathering with deep farm roots.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Held at the State Fairgrounds in St. Paul. Attendance in 2026 was 1,923,325, per KTTC.

minnesotaEvents.name: Minnesota State Fair
minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: Aug. 26 to Sept. 6, 2027; Aug. 24 to Sept. 4, 2028

entries.name: Minnesota Farmfest
entries.capsule: Three-day farm show near Redwood Falls with exhibitors and candidate forums.
entries.whatItMarks: Farm business, politics and policy in one place.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Held at the Gilfillan Estate on 50 acres. In 2026 it had over 400 exhibitors, debates for governor and U.S. Senate, and an address by U.S. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins.

entries.name: Minnesota Farm Families of the Year
entries.capsule: University of Minnesota Extension honors farm families county by county at Farmfest.
entries.whatItMarks: Commitment to agriculture, as chosen by local Extension committees.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: In 2026, 86 families were honored at the Wick Buildings Farmfest Center near Redwood Falls.

entries.name: County fair season
entries.capsule: Each county's fair brings 4-H, livestock and neighbors together through summer.
entries.dateRule: Set by each county fair board, mostly July and August.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Southeast Minnesota fairs are listed on their own entries. A statewide list could not be read.

entries.name: Olmsted County Fair
entries.capsule: Rochester-area county fair.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Held in Olmsted County. KROC gives July 27 to Aug. 2, 2026; KAAL agrees.

entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Dates announced by the board; venue not given in the article.

entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: KAAL's roundup names 2026 for this fair.

entries.name: Firearms deer opener
entries.capsule: Saturday in November when many Minnesota families head to deer camp.
entries.dateRule: Set by the DNR; a Saturday in early November.
entries.whatItMarks: The start of firearms deer season.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The DNR expects more than 400,000 hunters in 2026. End dates shown are for 100 series areas; 200 and 300 series end sooner.

minnesotaEvents.name: Firearms deer Season A
minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: Nov. 7 to 22, 2026 in 100 series; Nov. 7 to 15 in 200 and 300 series

entries.name: Minnesota fishing opener
entries.capsule: A spring Saturday when anglers return to the lakes.
entries.dateRule: Set by the DNR; a Saturday in May.
entries.whatItMarks: Start of fishing season on Minnesota waters.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Statewide; the DNR page lists a general opener and refers readers to regulations for each species.

entries.name: Governor's Fishing Opener
entries.capsule: A host town welcomes the governor and anglers on opening weekend.
entries.dateRule: Host and dates announced each year.
entries.whatItMarks: Tourism and the host town's lakes.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Stillwater hosted in 2026 on the St. Croix; Cold Spring hosts in 2027, centered on Long Lake.

entries.name: Western Minnesota Steam Threshers Reunion
entries.capsule: Labor Day show of steam threshing, parades and old farm machinery at Rollag.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Volunteers run it on 210 acres. It began as an informal 1940 gathering and opened to the public in 1954.

entries.name: Kolacky Days
entries.capsule: Montgomery's Czech heritage festival, begun in 1929 as a harvest celebration.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Events include a prune-spitting contest, a Bohemian tractor pull and a Sunday parade, per organizer Maureen Franek in 2024.

entries.name: Henderson Sauerkraut Days
entries.capsule: Three days of parades, a kraut run and an eating contest in Henderson.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Citywide, with a Grand Parade, tractor ride and eating contest.

entries.name: Potato Days
entries.capsule: Barnesville's one-day potato festival, with lefse and mashed potato sculpting.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Dates to the late 1930s, with the National Lefse Cookoff.

entries.name: Blueberry/Art Festival

entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Date listing only; details were not read from the organizer.

entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Date listing only; details were not read from the organizer.

entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: KROC also lists Aug. 24 to 25, 2026, which falls on weekdays and could not be confirmed from the organizer.

minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: July 17 to 18 and Aug. 24 to 25, 2026, as listed by KROC

entries.name: Fall harvest
entries.capsule: Months of long days in fields and beet piles across Minnesota.
entries.dateRule: Varies with crop and weather, roughly September through early November.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Not a single event. American Crystal finished its beet harvest Oct. 24, 2026. Southern Minnesota was 65 percent corn and 93 percent soybeans by Oct. 25, 2026.

entries.name: National Rural Health Day and Rural Health Policy Summit
entries.capsule: A November day for rural health, marked in St. Cloud by a policy summit.
entries.dateRule: National Rural Health Day; rule not read from a national source.
entries.whatItMarks: Rural health care and its workers.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: 2nd Annual summit at the Best Western Kelly Inn, St. Cloud, 9 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

entries.name: Agriculture Day
entries.capsule: A March day proclaimed to recognize farming.
entries.dateRule: Proclaimed yearly; date not fixed in the source.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Gov. Walz proclaimed March 24, 2026, as Agriculture Day and used it to press for tariff relief.

entries.name: Judy Garland Fan Festival
entries.capsule: Grand Rapids festival honoring its famous daughter.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The museum lists a 2026 Fan Festival but the page gives no dates.

entries.name: Sweet Beet 5K
entries.capsule: A farmer-owned sugar cooperative's run and walk in Renville.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Run and walk promoted by Southern Minnesota Beet Sugar Cooperative.

entries.name: Minnesota Farmers Union State Convention
entries.capsule: Yearly meeting where farm members set policy.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: At the Delta Hotel Minneapolis Northeast in 2026.

entries.name: Greater Education Summit
entries.capsule: Rural education leaders meet in November.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Place not stated on the page.

entries.name: King Turkey Day
entries.capsule: Worthington's September festival with a turkey race against Cuero, Texas, a parade, pancakes and a 10K.
entries.dateRule: Second Saturday after Labor Day, per FORWARD Worthington.

dates.source: King Turkey Day 5K/10K registration page linked by FORWARD Worthington

entries.whatItMarks: Worthington's turkey industry and town pride.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: A volunteer board names parade marshals and an Honorary Turkey at a downtown mixer. Traditions include serving pancakes, the 5K and 10K runs around Lake Okabena, the Great Gobbler Gallop on 10th Street in which Worthington's turkey Paycheck races Cuero, Texas' Ruby Begonia, and an afternoon parade (2 p.m. in the race schedule).

Cuero, Worthington turkey teams prepare for the Great Gobbler Gallop

entries.name: Pheasant season opener
entries.capsule: Saturday in October when pheasant season opens across southern, central and western Minnesota.
entries.dateRule: Set by the DNR each year; opens at 9 a.m. on a Saturday in mid-October.
entries.whatItMarks: The start of the fall pheasant hunt.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The DNR's 2026 roadside count was 90 pheasants per 100 miles, up nearly 20 percent from 2025, with the best prospects in the west central and southwest regions.

sources.title: DNR Fish and Wildlife Almanac, Sept. 29

entries.name: Governor's Pheasant Hunting Opener
entries.capsule: Yearly opener weekend hosted by a different Minnesota town; Northfield hosted in 2026.
entries.dateRule: Held on pheasant opening weekend in a host town chosen by application.
entries.whatItMarks: Pheasant hunting, public hunting lands and the host community.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: In 2026 Northfield hosted, with a Rooster Round-Up street dance and food trucks in Bridge Square on Oct. 9 and hunting on Oct. 10. The DNR noted the 75th anniversary of wildlife management areas.

sources.title: Northfield readies for 2026 Minnesota Governor's Pheasant Hunting Opener

entries.name: Waterfowl season opener
entries.capsule: Late-September Saturday when Minnesota's regular duck and goose seasons open.
entries.dateRule: Set by the DNR each year; regular season opens 30 minutes before sunrise on a late-September Saturday. Early teal and goose seasons start earlier.
entries.whatItMarks: The start of the regular duck and goose hunting seasons.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: In 2026 duck seasons ran Sept. 26 to Nov. 24 in the North zone, with split seasons in the Central and South zones. The DNR asked early-season hunters to take care around wild rice beds and harvesters, and to follow Tribal restrictions on three reservations.

sources.title: Waterfowl hunting seasons are on the horizon
DNR Fish and Wildlife Almanac, Sept. 21
